name: PocketDo
description: ✅ PocketDo: a minimalist to-do list and daily habit tracker that syncs between your iPhone and your computer. Lists, recurring tasks, streaks, 12 themes, EN/FR 📱💻

paragraphs: PocketDo is a minimalist to-do list and daily habit tracker that runs in the browser. It is designed to be added to the iPhone home screen, where it opens as a standalone app, and to be used on a computer in any web browser. Changes made on one device appear on the others automatically.
features: Lists to group tasks, each with its own colour (for example one list per course or project), plus a General list for everything else
Optional date, notes and repeat rules: every n days, every n weeks on chosen weekdays, or every n months
Completing a repeating task moves it to its next date
Completed tasks are hidden from the active list and can be shown again at any time
Swipe right to complete, swipe left to delete (with undo), drag the handle to reorder
